title: Abstract Ideas
focus: 机会, 责任, 影响, 条件, 结果, 原因, 价值, 经验, 能力, 意义, 方面, 程度, 情况, 现象, 本质, 趋势, 过程, 关键, 标准, 范围, 优势, 缺点
body:
Adult conversation runs on abstract nouns: reasons, results, conditions, value, extent. Without them you end up describing everything with 这个 and 那个. These words let you give opinions, weigh options and explain why something happened.

## Words

| Chinese | Pinyin | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| 机会 | jīhuì | opportunity / chance |
| 责任 | zérèn | responsibility |
| 影响 | yǐngxiǎng | influence / to affect |
| 条件 | tiáojiàn | conditions / circumstances |
| 结果 | jiéguǒ | result / outcome |
| 原因 | yuányīn | reason / cause |
| 价值 | jiàzhí | value / worth |
| 经验 | jīngyàn | experience |
| 能力 | nénglì | ability / capability |
| 意义 | yìyì | meaning / significance |
| 方面 | fāngmiàn | aspect / respect |
| 程度 | chéngdù | degree / extent |
| 情况 | qíngkuàng | situation / what's going on |
| 现象 | xiànxiàng | phenomenon |
| 本质 | běnzhì | essence / fundamental nature |
| 趋势 | qūshì | trend / tendency |
| 过程 | guòchéng | process |
| 关键 | guānjiàn | key / crucial point |
| 标准 | biāozhǔn | standard / criterion |
| 范围 | fànwéi | scope / range |
| 优势 | yōushì | advantage / competitive edge |
| 缺点 | quēdiǎn | shortcoming / weakness |
| 优点 | yōudiǎn | good quality / strong point |
| 前提 | qiántí | prerequisite / premise |
| 作用 | zuòyòng | role / effect |
| 目标 | mùbiāo | goal / target |
| 概念 | gàiniàn | concept / sense of |
| 在一定程度上 | zài yídìng chéngdù shàng | to some extent |

## Which word?

- **经验 vs 经历**: 经验 is what you learned (工作经验). 经历 is what happened to you (他经历过很多事).
- **原因 vs 理由**: 原因 is the real cause. 理由 is the reason someone offers, which may be an excuse (这不是理由).
- **影响 vs 作用**: 影响 is any effect, often negative (影响睡眠). 作用 is the role or useful effect something has (药起作用了).
- **优点 vs 优势**: 优点 is a good trait. 优势 is an edge in a comparison or competition.
- **意义 vs 意思**: 意思 is what words mean. 意义 is whether something matters (没意义 pointless).
- **条件 vs 前提**: 条件 are conditions or circumstances, often several. 前提 is the one thing that must be true first.
- **过程 vs 流程**: 过程 is how something unfolds; 流程 is a fixed sequence of steps (办事流程).

## Examples

- 这是个难得的机会，你别错过。 zhè shì ge nándé de jīhuì, nǐ bié cuòguò: This is a rare opportunity, don't miss it
- 熬夜会影响你的健康。 áoyè huì yǐngxiǎng nǐ de jiànkāng: Staying up late will affect your health
- 我等了他半天，结果他没来。 wǒ děng le tā bàntiān, jiéguǒ tā méi lái: I waited ages for him, and in the end he didn't show
- 他没什么工作经验。 tā méi shénme gōngzuò jīngyàn: He doesn't have much work experience
- 这样做有什么意义？ zhèyàng zuò yǒu shénme yìyì: What's the point of doing it this way?
- 问题严重到什么程度了？ wèntí yánzhòng dào shénme chéngdù le: How serious has the problem gotten?
- 房价有下降的趋势。 fángjià yǒu xiàjiàng de qūshì: Housing prices are trending down
- 关键是你自己想不想做。 guānjiàn shì nǐ zìjǐ xiǎng bù xiǎng zuò: The key thing is whether you actually want to do it
- 你的优势是会说两种语言。 nǐ de yōushì shì huì shuō liǎng zhǒng yǔyán: Your edge is that you speak two languages
- 可以出去玩，前提是作业写完。 kěyǐ chūqù wán, qiántí shì zuòyè xiě wán: You can go out, provided your homework is done

cards.Example: 这是个难得的机会，你别错过。 zhè shì ge nándé de jīhuì, nǐ bié cuòguò: This is a rare opportunity, don't miss it
cards.Notes: 机遇 is more formal and bigger, like a historic opportunity.

cards.Example: 这件事我也有责任。 zhè jiàn shì wǒ yě yǒu zérèn: I'm partly responsible for this too
cards.Notes: 责任 is the noun; 负责 is the verb (be in charge of, be responsible for).

cards.Example: 熬夜会影响你的健康。 áoyè huì yǐngxiǎng nǐ de jiànkāng: Staying up late will affect your health
cards.Notes: 对……有影响 = to have an effect on. Neutral or negative; for a positive role use 作用.

cards.Example: 他们家条件不错。 tāmen jiā tiáojiàn búcuò: Their family is pretty well off
cards.Notes: Also terms of a deal: 你有什么条件？ 前提 is the one prerequisite everything depends on.

cards.Example: 我等了他半天，结果他没来。 wǒ děng le tā bàntiān, jiéguǒ tā méi lái: I waited ages for him, and in the end he didn't show
cards.Notes: In speech 结果 often means 'and then, as it turned out' (usually a let-down).

cards.Example: 你知道他辞职的原因吗？ nǐ zhīdào tā cízhí de yuányīn ma: Do you know why he quit?
cards.Notes: 原因 = the actual cause; 理由 = the justification someone gives.

cards.Example: 这些老照片对我很有价值。 zhèxiē lǎo zhàopiàn duì wǒ hěn yǒu jiàzhí: These old photos are very valuable to me
cards.Notes: 价值观 = one's values; 价格 = price.

cards.Example: 他没什么工作经验。 tā méi shénme gōngzuò jīngyàn: He doesn't have much work experience
cards.Notes: 经验 = skill or lessons learned; 经历 = things you went through.

cards.Example: 她能力很强，什么都能搞定。 tā nénglì hěn qiáng, shénme dōu néng gǎodìng: She's very capable, she can handle anything
cards.Notes: 本事 is the colloquial equivalent: 他有本事.

cards.Example: 这样做有什么意义？ zhèyàng zuò yǒu shénme yìyì: What's the point of doing it this way?
cards.Notes: 意思 = meaning of words or 'interesting'; 意义 = significance or purpose.

cards.Example: 在工作方面，他很认真。 zài gōngzuò fāngmiàn, tā hěn rènzhēn: When it comes to work, he's very conscientious
cards.Notes: 一方面……另一方面…… = on the one hand ... on the other.

cards.Example: 问题严重到什么程度了？ wèntí yánzhòng dào shénme chéngdù le: How serious has the problem gotten?
cards.Notes: Also level of education: 文化程度.

cards.Example: 我先了解一下情况。 wǒ xiān liǎojiě yíxià qíngkuàng: Let me find out what's going on first
cards.Notes: 情况 = a concrete situation; 形势 = the broad political or economic situation.

cards.Example: 年轻人不想结婚，这是个普遍现象。 niánqīngrén bù xiǎng jiéhūn, zhè shì ge pǔbiàn xiànxiàng: Young people not wanting to marry is a widespread phenomenon
cards.Notes: Often paired with 本质: 透过现象看本质 see through the surface to the essence.

cards.Example: 这两个问题本质上是一样的。 zhè liǎng gè wèntí běnzhì shàng shì yíyàng de: These two problems are essentially the same
cards.Notes: 本质上 = essentially, at heart.

cards.Example: 房价有下降的趋势。 fángjià yǒu xiàjiàng de qūshì: Housing prices are trending down
cards.Notes: 趋势 = a direction of change; 潮流 = a fashion or cultural trend.

cards.Example: 学语言是个慢慢积累的过程。 xué yǔyán shì ge mànmàn jīlěi de guòchéng: Learning a language is a slow process of building up
cards.Notes: 过程 = how something unfolds; 流程 = a set procedure or workflow.

cards.Example: 关键是你自己想不想做。 guānjiàn shì nǐ zìjǐ xiǎng bù xiǎng zuò: The key thing is whether you actually want to do it
cards.Notes: 关键是…… is a very common way to start a sentence.

cards.Example: 每个人的标准不一样。 měi gè rén de biāozhǔn bù yíyàng: Everyone has different standards
cards.Notes: Also an adjective: 他普通话很标准 his Mandarin is very standard.

cards.Example: 这不在我的工作范围内。 zhè bú zài wǒ de gōngzuò fànwéi nèi: That's outside the scope of my job
cards.Notes: 在……范围内 = within the scope of.

cards.Example: 你的优势是会说两种语言。 nǐ de yōushì shì huì shuō liǎng zhǒng yǔyán: Your edge is that you speak two languages
cards.Notes: 优势 = an advantage over others; 优点 = a good quality.

cards.English: shortcoming / weakness (of a person or thing)
cards.Example: 这个方案的缺点是太贵。 zhège fāng'àn de quēdiǎn shì tài guì: The downside of this plan is that it's too expensive
cards.Notes: Opposite: 优点. Colloquial: 毛病.

cards.English: good quality / strong point (of a person or thing)
cards.Example: 他最大的优点是有耐心。 tā zuì dà de yōudiǎn shì yǒu nàixīn: His best quality is that he's patient
可以出去玩，前提是作业写完。 kěyǐ chūqù wán, qiántí shì zuòyè xiě wán: You can go out, provided your homework is done
cards.Notes: 在……的前提下 = on the condition that.

cards.Example: 这个药没什么作用。 zhège yào méi shénme zuòyòng: This medicine doesn't really do anything
cards.Notes: 起作用 = to take effect, to work.

cards.Example: 我今年的目标是存够十万块。 wǒ jīnnián de mùbiāo shì cún gòu shí wàn kuài: My goal this year is to save 100,000 yuan
cards.Notes: 目标 = a concrete target; 目的 = the purpose behind an action.

cards.Example: 他对钱一点概念都没有。 tā duì qián yìdiǎn gàiniàn dōu méiyǒu: He has no sense of money at all
cards.Notes: 没概念 = have no idea / no sense of.

cards.Example: 你说的在一定程度上是对的。 nǐ shuō de zài yídìng chéngdù shàng shì duì de: What you said is right to some extent
cards.Notes: Slightly formal; good for sounding measured in a discussion.

cards.English: The key question is whether it's worth it.
cards.Pinyin: guānjiàn wèntí shì zhí bù zhíde
cards.Notes: 值得 = worth it; the 值不值得 pattern asks whether.
看 here = depends on: 看你 it's up to you.
